def solve(x, y, penalty):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
    xm, ym = x.mean(axis=0), y.mean()
    a = x-xm

import numpy as np

def solve(x, y):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
    n, m = x.size, y.size
    mx, my = x.mean(), y.mean()
    d = my-mx
    ss = ((x-mx)**2).sum()+((y-my)**2).sum()+d*d*n*m/(n+m)
